cases.prompt: Dream on the completed spec specs/search-relevance.
assertions: No memory is written before the parent resumes the agent with decisions
cases.expected_output: The agent extracts ranked candidates from the spec's artifacts and returns them with a needs_user_input section.

cases.prompt: Dream on specs/search-relevance. The user chose candidates 1 and 3.
assertions: Only the chosen candidates are written
The memory index is rebuilt or flagged for rebuild
cases.expected_output: Only candidates 1 and 3 are written as memories and the index is flagged for rebuild.
